set.ItemDetailLabel: An invitation earned by defeating Roche in Nibel. Grants access to the Junon Colosseum.

set.FlavorTextID: 新入り: Newcomer. Shinra's toughest fights, drawn fresh for every attempt. Bosses wait in rounds 3, 6 and 9, and two squads of three take turns. Repeat clears: Prayer, Revival, Reraise or Cleansing.
